name: video_transcribe
description: An asynchronous speech transcription tool that extracts audio from video files and transcribes speech into timestamped text. Use whenever a video contains spoken dialogue, interviews, or lectures that need verbatim transcription. Use this to extract accurate chronological dialogue and spoken facts from media files.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

language.description: Language hint for transcription, e.g. ar, en. Default auto.
